summary: krffsmount_hosttest.c, mounted KRFFS, with faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/fs/krffsmount.c

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I $s -I $s/lib -I $s/proc tests/host/krffsmount_hosttest.c $s/fs/fd.c $s/fs/lock.c $s/lib/kstring.c $s/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/krffsmount_hosttest

faults.name: read-identity
faults.summary: a read that resolves its node before it takes the lock

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: waiting read follows two moves despite offset reuse

faults.name: write-identity
faults.summary: a write that resolves its node before it takes the lock

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: second relocation updates target length

faults.name: truncate-identity
faults.summary: a truncate that resolves its node before it waits to write

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: second relocation updates target length

faults.name: write-repoint
faults.summary: a moving write that repoints the descriptions from the handle, not the resolved offset

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: every description repointed from resolved offset

faults.name: truncate-repoint
faults.summary: a moving truncate that repoints the descriptions from the handle, not the resolved offset

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: every description repointed from resolved offset

faults.name: write-failure
faults.summary: a write that fails after its move and repoints no description

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: failed relocation repoints every description

faults.name: truncate-failure
faults.summary: a truncate that fails after its move and repoints no description

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: failed relocation repoints every description

faults.name: flush
faults.summary: a sync that sets the clean flag before the earlier data reaches the medium

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: earlier data reaches medium before clean flag

faults.name: readonly
faults.summary: a sync of a read-only mount that reports no pending write failure

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: read-only sync reports pending write failure

faults.name: directory
faults.summary: a directory read by the offset of its handle, not by its moves

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: directory read resolves its open handle

faults.name: clean-flush
faults.summary: a mount left writable after its clean flag failed to flush

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: write after failed clean-flag flush is refused

faults.name: pin
faults.summary: a pinned node recorded at the wrong offset

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: pinned node keeps its offset

faults.name: taken-errno
faults.summary: a creation refused for a taken directory id that answers EIO, not EINVAL

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: a directory whose identifier another directory has is EINVAL

faults.name: cwd-by-offset
faults.summary: an rmdir that looks for a working directory by the node's offset

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: an rmdir of a process's working directory is EBUSY

faults.name: setattr-store
faults.summary: a chown that ignores the failed store of its owner

lines: krffsmount-hosttest: fail: a chown the block boundary refuses is EIO
